Raft consensus requires a quorum of 2 nodes to commit a log entry. The leader sends 200ms heartbeats to prevent follower election timeouts. Network partitions cause the minority partition to stop accepting writes. Log compaction via snapshotting reduces replay time after a crash. etcd and CockroachDB both implement Raft for replicated state machines.

Multi-Paxos consensus coordinates distributed replicated state without a single permanent master. Leader leases establish proposal rights for lease terms of 100ms before re-election. In the accept phase, a commit quorum of 4 acceptors must acknowledge the ballot number. Proposers resolve ballot conflicts through randomized backoff intervals. Google Chubby and Apache ZooKeeper incorporate Paxos-family consensus protocols.

Epidemic gossip protocols spread cluster membership updates in logarithmic rounds. The phi accrual failure detector triggers node suspicion after a 250ms suspicion timeout. If network ping latency pushes the accrual metric past 0.9, the cluster marks the node dead. Anti-entropy background exchanges repair missing data versions across healthy nodes. Apache Cassandra relies on gossip for ring state coordination.

The SWIM membership protocol provides weakly-consistent cluster membership with bounded false-positive rates. Nodes transmit ping probes periodically with a ping interval of 100ms. When an indirect ping probe fails, suspect timeout counters initiate dead-node eviction after crossing 0.7
